text: Surface identity now composes semantic SpaceKey with exact ordered SurfaceMeshDomain topology. SurfaceField and SurfaceRoi are compatibility views over IndexedField, Section, and Region; LabeledSurface becomes a quotient plus parcel-indexed metadata and display Selection. Disconnected same-label fibers remain valid parcellation blocks; FragmentedParcelPolicy remains a surface-geometry concern. Metric searchlights lower to centered Relation values with closed-ball radius semantics.
